camel_example: aliyun ens ListApplications --region cn-hangzhou --AppVersions 'v1,v2' --MaxDate '2022-02-20' --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --ClusterNames 'poc,pre' --Level National --MinDate '2022-02-15' --OutAppInfoParams '{\"appInfo\":true,\"detailStat\": true, \"appVersionStat\": true, \"districtStat\":true ,\"instanceStat\": true, \"podCountStat\": true}'
description_zh: 调用ListApplications列出创建的应用列表
kebab_example: aliyun ens list-applications --cluster-names poc,pre --app-versions v1,v2 --level National --out-app-info-params '{\"appInfo\":true,\"detailStat\": true, \"appVersionStat\": true, \"districtStat\":true ,\"instanceStat\": true, \"podCountStat\": true}' --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --min-date 2022-02-15 --max-date 2022-02-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListApplications

parameters.help_en: The names of the application clusters. You can specify multiple names separated by commas (,). Enter All to query applications in all clusters under your account. By default, all clusters are queried
parameters.help_zh: 应用集群名。支持多选，以","分割；输入All，查询用户名下所有集群的应用列表；默认查询全量
parameters.name: cluster_names

parameters.help_en: The business service version numbers of the applications. You can specify multiple version numbers separated by commas (,). Enter All to return data for all versions. By default, only data associated with stable versions is returned
parameters.help_zh: 应用的业务服务版本号。支持多选，以","分割；输入All，输出所有版本数据。默认只输出稳定版版本号的关联数据
parameters.name: app_versions

parameters.help_en:
The regional statistical level of application edge resources. Valid values:

National: nationwide
Big: major region
Middle: province
Small: city
RegionId: edge node

Default value: National
parameters.help_zh:
应用边缘资源的区域统计级别。枚举类型，取值范围：

National：全国
Big：大区
Middle：省级
Small：城市
RegionId：边缘节点

默认National
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return information in dimensions such as statistical resource instances and container pods. The value is a JSON string. By default, all information is returned
parameters.help_zh: 是否输出统计资源实例/容器Pod等维度的信息。Json的字符串格式。默认输出所有信息
parameters.name: out_app_info_params

parameters.help_en: The page number. The minimum value is 1. This parameter is not required when you export all information
parameters.help_zh: 页码，起始值为1，导出全部信息时可不传入
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in the paging Settings for a paged query. This parameter is not required when you export all entries
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，导出全部时可不传入
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. By default, no time limit is applied
parameters.help_zh: 查询起始时间，格式"2006-01-02"；默认无时间限制
parameters.name: min_date

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. By default, no time limit is applied
parameters.help_zh: 查询终止时间，格式"2006-01-02"；默认无时间限制
parameters.name: max_date

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the paged query

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for the paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数
